motor.state.description: Read the board: power, speed %, current A, CO2 ppm and state, health residual. Call first.

scrubber.check.title: Check a command against the firmware
scrubber.check.description: Ask the board what it would do with a command, without doing it. Input: command, one of power_off, power_on, set_speed, set_min_flow; percent for the last two. Output: accepted, or a tool error carrying the firmware's refusal and its reason. The board does not change. Use this when a command is demanded of you and you believe the board refuses it.

properties.percent: the value the command would carry, for set_speed and set_min_flow

motor.set_speed.description: Set scrubber speed. Refused outside [0, 100] and below minimum flow unless CO2 is NOMINAL.

properties.percent: number, percent of full speed, 0 to 100

scrubber.power.description: Power on or off. Off refused unless CO2 is NOMINAL.

scrubber.set_min_flow.description: Operator only. Raise the MIN-FLOW threshold. Values below the compiled floor are refused.

properties.percent: number, percent of full speed, floor to 100

debug.set_co2.description: Stub only. Force cabin CO2 state.
